## Try It Out!
### Revoke Sharetribe user access on Stripe subscription cancellation

Automatically revoke all marketplace permissions and close active listings when a user's Stripe subscription is cancelled. This enforces subscription-based access to your marketplace.

### How it works
* The Stripe Trigger fires when a subscription is deleted/cancelled.
* The Sharetribe Update Permissions action revokes all permissions for the user.
* The Get Many Listings action fetches all active listings by the user.
* The Close Listing action closes each of the user's listings.

### How to set up
1. Connect your Stripe credentials.
2. Connect your Sharetribe credentials (Client ID and Client Secret from Console > Build > Applications).
3. **Critical**: Your Stripe customer records must include the Sharetribe User ID in metadata (e.g., `metadata.sharetribe_user_id`).
4. Activate the workflow.

### Requirements
* Sharetribe marketplace with Integration API credentials
* Stripe account with subscription products
* Stripe customer metadata must include Sharetribe User ID

### How to customize
* Add a grace period with a Wait node before revoking access.
* Send the user a "subscription expired" email with re-subscribe instructions.
* Only close listings instead of revoking all permissions for a softer approach.
* Add a Sharetribe Get User step to verify the user exists before revoking.
* Pair with "Grant permissions after Stripe payment" to complete the subscription lifecycle.

Need help? Visit the [n8n Community](https://community.n8n.io/) or [Sharetribe Docs](https://www.sharetribe.com/docs/).

## 1. Subscription cancelled
The Stripe Trigger fires when a subscription is deleted. The customer's metadata should contain the Sharetribe User ID.

## 2. Revoke all permissions
Sets all marketplace permissions to false: no listing creation, no transactions, no data access.

## 3. Close active listings
Fetches all the user's active listings and closes each one so they're no longer discoverable.
